role.description: The role of the user in the app

glow_mode.description: Controls how much of the profile is visible to visitors

privacy_tier.description: Controls who can access the user's profile at all

profile_photo_url.description: URL of the user's uploaded profile photo

username.description: Unique @handle for the user, used for mentions

bio.description: Short About Me text shown on the user's profile (max 160 chars)

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code detected from IP on first login (e.g. US, FR, GB)

currency_code.description: Local currency code detected alongside country (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP) — used for price display

price_emails_opted_in.description: Whether the user has opted in to weekly price-drop emails (default true; set to false on unsubscribe)

notification_prefs.description: JSON string of per-category in-app notification preferences. Parsed keys: museDuMatin, nouveautes, rappelsRituel, offresPrivees, productAlerts, communityUpdates, messages, ingredientAlerts (all boolean, default true unless otherwise noted)
